title: Player Trade
description: Adds trade between players to players into minecraft
body:
Player Trade adds the function to trade between Player to Player inside Minecraft!

**HOW TO USE:**
Client 1:
Use /trade <User>
Client 2:
Press the accept text in chat, then enter, or type /accept <User> to begin trading.

List of commands and uses:
1. /trade <User> (Trade a user)
2. /trade on (Enables trading)
3. /trade off (Disable trading)
4. /accept <User> (Accept a user's trade request)
5. /decline <User> (Decline a user's trade request

When done trading, both sides must press accept to register the trade. Then an item will appear in the recipient's inventory or hotbar. Simply right-click to use the item, and the traded loot will appear in their hotbar or inventory

**REQUIRES FABRIC API**
